title: Gunger talks murder

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: So I've been thinking about the perfect murder.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I've been thinking about the perfect murder.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You haven't?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You haven't?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I'm obsessed. OBSESSED! Can't get enough. Me and Marv talk about it all day long.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm obsessed. OBSESSED! Can't get enough. Me and Marv talk about it all day long.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I like your spirit! I feel I have a pretty good set up for a perfect murder. A murder that you could never be caught for committing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like your spirit! I feel I have a pretty good set up for a perfect murder. A murder that you could never be caught for committing.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Aww come on. Everyone has thought about it. Be honest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aww come on. Everyone has thought about it. Be honest.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Aw no, it's not like that. I don't got no enemies. Not really. It's just an interesting thought exercise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aw no, it's not like that. I don't got no enemies. Not really. It's just an interesting thought exercise.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: The Aseptic is sloppy. I got some ideas on how to do a better job. Want to share yours?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Aseptic is sloppy. I got some ideas on how to do a better job. Want to share yours?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Alright, say you're gonna off someone and you want to make sure you never get caught. How do you do it? Let's go step-by-step.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, say you're gonna off someone and you want to make sure you never get caught. How do you do it? Let's go step-by-step.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Aww come on. Just for fun.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aww come on. Just for fun.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: And here's the deal: if you can convince me you could get away with murder, I'll tell you how I'd do it. And my murder method... well I know it works.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And here's the deal: if you can convince me you could get away with murder, I'll tell you how I'd do it. And my murder method... well I know it works.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Right! So first off... who do you want to kill. No! Don't tell me. Just think of the victim. Hold them in your mind. Did you think of someone?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right! So first off... who do you want to kill. No! Don't tell me. Just think of the victim. Hold them in your mind. Did you think of someone?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Ok. Now, where do you off them? We need a location. Where can you get at someone without being spotted or identified? And remember, you need to catch them off-guard. Vulnerable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok. Now, where do you off them? We need a location. Where can you get at someone without being spotted or identified? And remember, you need to catch them off-guard. Vulnerable.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's an interesting choice. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's an interesting choice. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: A public place. But you get a moment of privacy, and you can get close. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A public place. But you get a moment of privacy, and you can get close. I like it! Now onto the method. How will you do it?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I like it! Quiet. No witnesses. Easy to get the jump on them. Now onto the method. How will you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like it! Quiet. No witnesses. Easy to get the jump on them. Now onto the method. How will you do it?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Public space, but lots of possibilities! I'm interested in why you chose there. What's your method?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Public space, but lots of possibilities! I'm interested in why you chose there. What's your method?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Ah yes! It would seem like an accident. But how would you drown them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah yes! It would seem like an accident. But how would you drown them?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Hey... that's pretty clever. Even if the electricity doesn't kill them outright, it will paralyze their muscles and they'll drown. Risky though... Electricity. Easy for that to backfire and shock you instead. And a pool full of water... very risky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey... that's pretty clever. Even if the electricity doesn't kill them outright, it will paralyze their muscles and they'll drown. Risky though... Electricity. Easy for that to backfire and shock you instead. And a pool full of water... very risky.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well... that's horrible. I like it. But that might not kill them outright. Even a strong acid - I think your method of murder must be more lethal. And where would you get that much acid? And transport it in secret? I dunno... the more I think about it, the less I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... that's horrible. I like it. But that might not kill them outright. Even a strong acid - I think your method of murder must be more lethal. And where would you get that much acid? And transport it in secret? I dunno... the more I think about it, the less I like it.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's a bit too up-close-and-personal. And what do you hit them with? That's a murder weapon. And maybe they fight back. It's... not great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a bit too up-close-and-personal. And what do you hit them with? That's a murder weapon. And maybe they fight back. It's... not great.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's... a really terrible idea. I mean why would they eat it? And if they did, why would they swim? And you don't drown because of a tummy ache. Are you even taking this seriously?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... a really terrible idea. I mean why would they eat it? And if they did, why would they swim? And you don't drown because of a tummy ache. Are you even taking this seriously?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That... could work. It would look like an accident, it's very effective, with no witnesses and no murder weapons. But... you'd have a co-conspirator. That's not a perfect murder. There's still a possibility you'd be caught. It's not foolproof.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That... could work. It would look like an accident, it's very effective, with no witnesses and no murder weapons. But... you'd have a co-conspirator. That's not a perfect murder. There's still a possibility you'd be caught. It's not foolproof.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: All well and good, but those purchases of protective gear would leave a paper trail. And electricity is still dangerous. And unpredictable. Your method is good... but not perfect.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All well and good, but those purchases of protective gear would leave a paper trail. And electricity is still dangerous. And unpredictable. Your method is good... but not perfect.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Simple. Effective. But loud. And messy. Blood splatter all over you. People would hear. What happens when you step out the lift if someone sees you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Simple. Effective. But loud. And messy. Blood splatter all over you. People would hear. What happens when you step out the lift if someone sees you?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I don't know if you understand how elevators work my friend, but when you cut the cord, the elevator doesn't go down. It stays in place. Or goes up. The counterweight you see...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know if you understand how elevators work my friend, but when you cut the cord, the elevator doesn't go down. It stays in place. Or goes up. The counterweight you see...

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: ... Hard to get caught... Easy delivery... You're nice and close... Easy escape... It's good. It's very good. You still need to source the poison. There's a murder weapon. And security cameras in the elevators.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Hard to get caught... Easy delivery... You're nice and close... Easy escape... It's good. It's very good. You still need to source the poison. There's a murder weapon. And security cameras in the elevators.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's suspiciously close to how the professionals do it. You still have a murder weapon, and need to procure a taser and poison, leaving a paper trail. But otherwise, that's a solid plan. Say, you aren't ex-military are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's suspiciously close to how the professionals do it. You still have a murder weapon, and need to procure a taser and poison, leaving a paper trail. But otherwise, that's a solid plan. Say, you aren't ex-military are you?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Indirect, and not too messy. But prone to error. You can't guarantee they'll take the poison. And you still need to SOURCE the poison. And break in. There are clear drawbacks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indirect, and not too messy. But prone to error. You can't guarantee they'll take the poison. And you still need to SOURCE the poison. And break in. There are clear drawbacks.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well that cuts down on mess, and minimizes noise. It's up close and personal though, and there's a murder weapon to dispose of. And how do you break in? I dunno. It's simple, which I like, but there's clear drawbacks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that cuts down on mess, and minimizes noise. It's up close and personal though, and there's a murder weapon to dispose of. And how do you break in? I dunno. It's simple, which I like, but there's clear drawbacks.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Poison. Right. But you're in a restaurant. How are you getting to their food? Sneaking in the kitchen? And what if someone else eats it? High risk...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poison. Right. But you're in a restaurant. How are you getting to their food? Sneaking in the kitchen? And what if someone else eats it? High risk...

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's... bold. But it feels like you're not even trying to create the perfect murder. The loudest perhaps. Witnesses, a murder weapon, blood splatter... it seems pretty terrible as a plan, I have to say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... bold. But it feels like you're not even trying to create the perfect murder. The loudest perhaps. Witnesses, a murder weapon, blood splatter... it seems pretty terrible as a plan, I have to say.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Sure, if they HAVE a neural augment that will work. Maybe. But you have to hire a hacker, so there's an accomplice. And hacks are expensive to buy, and even the pricey ones can be traced... as a murder plan, it's got some holes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, if they HAVE a neural augment that will work. Maybe. But you have to hire a hacker, so there's an accomplice. And hacks are expensive to buy, and even the pricey ones can be traced... as a murder plan, it's got some holes.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well that's smarter than sourcing a swimming pool full of acid. But you'd still need a lot of chemicals, you'd need to break in, and I'm still unsure of the lethality. It needs work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well that's smarter than sourcing a swimming pool full of acid. But you'd still need a lot of chemicals, you'd need to break in, and I'm still unsure of the lethality. It needs work.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: How would you trap them? And if they're already trapped in the pool, wouldn't they just drown eventually?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How would you trap them? And if they're already trapped in the pool, wouldn't they just drown eventually?

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well... it's grisly, I'll give you that. You don't have to get too close, and it might even look like an accident. Some logistical issues - getting the acid and all that. But not bad!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... it's grisly, I'll give you that. You don't have to get too close, and it might even look like an accident. Some logistical issues - getting the acid and all that. But not bad!

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That solves the mess problem. But you still have to dispose of the overalls. There's a murder weapon... I dunno. It's pretty weak overall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That solves the mess problem. But you still have to dispose of the overalls. There's a murder weapon... I dunno. It's pretty weak overall.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Well you sound confident enough. Which is weird. But I still don't buy it. There's plenty of more subtle methods.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you sound confident enough. Which is weird. But I still don't buy it. There's plenty of more subtle methods.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You're an elevator engineer now are you? I dunno. I'm not sold.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're an elevator engineer now are you? I dunno. I'm not sold.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You're an elevator technician now are you? I guess you could learn how to do it. And it's unique, I'll give you that. It allows for privacy. Sneaky. I don't think anyone has tried it before. I... like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're an elevator technician now are you? I guess you could learn how to do it. And it's unique, I'll give you that. It allows for privacy. Sneaky. I don't think anyone has tried it before. I... like it.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Connections, eh? And a poison needle is pretty easy to conceal. You've put some thought into this one. I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Connections, eh? And a poison needle is pretty easy to conceal. You've put some thought into this one. I like it.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You're a hacker now? Or you're going to recruit one? Too many leads going back to you. Accomplices, traceable hacks. I don't like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a hacker now? Or you're going to recruit one? Too many leads going back to you. Accomplices, traceable hacks. I don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: You're an engineer now are you? And how do you get into the apartment next door? That's just pushing the problem one door over! You're not taking this seriously...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're an engineer now are you? And how do you get into the apartment next door? That's just pushing the problem one door over! You're not taking this seriously...

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Easier to intercept, and it's easy to pay off a delivery driver, or impersonate them. It's not a bad plan...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Easier to intercept, and it's easy to pay off a delivery driver, or impersonate them. It's not a bad plan...

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That takes some expertise. You're putting yourself in danger breaking in, and the method is not foolproof. I don't like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That takes some expertise. You're putting yourself in danger breaking in, and the method is not foolproof. I don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: Chilling. I like it. Good work. You creepy motherfucker.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Chilling. I like it. Good work. You creepy motherfucker.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: It's not bad, but... It's too easy to get rumbled. Most restaurants will spot a fake waiter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not bad, but... It's too easy to get rumbled. Most restaurants will spot a fake waiter.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: That's very clever. Not perfect but... I think it's simple and you can make a quick getaway. Gonna be hard to catch you. Nice plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's very clever. Not perfect but... I think it's simple and you can make a quick getaway. Gonna be hard to catch you. Nice plan.

nodes.speaker: Gunger Hahn
nodes.text: I'll tell you. Another time. For now, I gotta go. But I enjoyed the chat. Thanks for indulging me. And don't go killing anyone for real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell you. Another time. For now, I gotta go. But I enjoyed the chat. Thanks for indulging me. And don't go killing anyone for real.
